issues.where: horizon and midground grass field across cut 2 from f0599 to f0600
issues.what: the horizon and midground grass do not line up across the cut: the flat treeline and tall grass meadow in f0599 jump in one frame to a higher mountain ridge, a bright misty valley band below the former treeline, and dark midground sunflower silhouettes in f0600
issues.fix: keep the horizon ridge silhouette, midground grass, and background plant geometry aligned across f0599 and f0600 so only sky, lighting, and weather change on the cut

issues.where: lower-center and lower-right rim of the flower disc across f1393 to f1404
issues.what: unfolding orange-yellow ray petals sweep directly through one another and through surrounding green bracts, forming hard X-shaped geometry intersections across all 12 frames
issues.fix: resolve petal-to-petal and petal-to-bract collisions or stagger unfolding trajectories so ray florets clear neighboring petals and bracts without interpenetrating

issues.where: sunlit foreground soil clods on the left and right of the sprout across f0000 to f0011
issues.what: subpixel micro-highlights on bumpy soil grains blink on and off every frame as the camera creeps downward, producing strong crawling specular shimmer across the dirt bed
issues.fix: prefilter high-frequency soil roughness/specular glints and increase temporal-spatial supersampling so highlights evolve smoothly without twinkling

issues.where: split striped seed husk on the soil to the left of the stem base in f0120 to f0125
issues.what: the shed seed husk has heavy motion-blur ghosting in f0120 that snaps off to razor-sharp in f0121 and then rocks at real-time speed across f0121 to f0125 while the cotyledons unfold at time-lapse speed
issues.fix: drop the seed husk cleanly between time-lapse exposures so it rests statically on the soil without a single-frame smear pop or multi-frame real-time bounce

issues.where: left tip of the emerging hypocotyl arch and striped seed-coat prongs in f0006 to f0011
issues.what: the rising striped seed-coat prongs pass straight through static sunlit soil clods on the left edge of the hole without displacing or crumbling the intersected dirt
issues.fix: push aside and crumble the overlying soil clods ahead of the rising seed coat and hypocotyl hook so plant geometry never intersects static soil

issues.where: left and upper-left unfolding yellow ray petals and adjacent green bracts across f1341 to f1352
issues.what: emerging yellow ray petals pass directly through overlapping green bracts and neighboring petals instead of peeling the bracts outward first
issues.fix: open the outer green phyllaries ahead of the ray florets and separate neighboring petal paths to prevent interpenetration

issues.where: rain streaks crossing the cotyledons and upper leaves across f0290 to f0301
issues.what: falling rain streaks slice straight across and through the leaves without landing, splashing, or deflecting individual leaves, while surface water beads remain frozen in place
issues.fix: collide raindrops with leaf surfaces to produce small impact splashes, dynamic droplet motion, and subtle independent leaf bounce under raindrop weight

issues.where: pinpoint stars across the night sky in f0894 to f0899 (also in set-D-05.png f0600 to f0605)
issues.what: as the starfield drifts subpixel-by-subpixel, 1-pixel stars alias across the pixel grid and fluctuate strongly in peak brightness from frame to frame, causing crawling star shimmer
issues.fix: render pinpoint stars with a slightly wider prefiltered point-spread function and higher spatial supersampling so subpixel drift maintains steady star brightness

issues.where: backlit trichome hairs along the left outer bract and upper bract tips across f1217 to f1228
issues.what: fine rim-lit hairs break up into disconnected 1-pixel bright dots that sparkle and crawl from frame to frame as the bud shifts slowly
issues.fix: supersample and prefilter thin backlit trichome hairs so rim highlights stay continuous and temporally stable

issues.where: background fog and mist in the frost scene across f0900 to f0905 (also in set-D-07.png f1194 to f1199)
issues.what: unlike the drifting mist in the dawn and night segments, the frost-scene fog and haze remain nearly static across consecutive frames
issues.fix: add slow lateral advection and subtle density variation to the morning frost fog so the mist visibly drifts
